name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 8 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.89 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
